name: Dixon–Coles goals model
description: Poisson goals with a low-score correction; attack and defence ratings per team with one-year half-life time decay, home advantage per competition, shrinkage toward average for thin samples. Corners and cards from negative-binomial rate models.

name: Claude match explainer
description: Claude reads the match packet and the model's probabilities, names factors for and against, and flags data gaps. It does not set probabilities.
